name: Neuromate
description: The Renishaw neuromate is a highly accurate and repeatable stereotactic neurosurgical robot designed for a wide range of applications. It assists neurosurgeons in performing delicate procedures with enhanced precision and consistency. Key applications include Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) for Parkinson's disease, epilepsy, and essential tremor; Stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) for epilepsy monitoring; brain biopsies; neuroendoscopy; and targeted drug delivery. The system features six degrees of freedom and can be used in both frame-based and frameless modes. It has been used in over 10,000 procedures for more than 20 years. The robot integrates with neuroinspire surgical planning software for efficient procedure planning.
